decisions.reason: Delaying the table-of-contents page-number update until book size is finalized does not change the required illustrations, their placement, or their visual criteria.
The source decision changes only the timing of the table-of-contents page-number update and leaves the general paperback interior-layout requirement unchanged.
The table-of-contents page-number timing has no necessary effect on Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, line roles, or capitalization.
The source decision concerns document navigation after size finalization and does not alter manuscript wording or copyediting requirements.
The timing of table-of-contents page numbering does not change the prohibition on the literal newline artifact in the book title.
The source decision does not change the copyright-page publisher line or its layout.
The table-of-contents page-number update timing neither resolves nor changes the uncertainty about the interior title page's content and image usage.
The source decision does not change the required back matter or author copy.

Although finalized book size may be relevant to cover production generally, this source decision only establishes when table-of-contents page numbers will be updated and does not change the cover requirement.
